purpose: Design concepts only; not runtime textures or in-engine captures

prompts.environment:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: architectural art-direction hero image for Realm, a medieval 3D coworking world, CONCEPT ONLY.
Primary request: visually photoreal AAA 3D environment concept, the architectural realism and physically grounded light of an Unreal Engine cinematic. This is a functioning late-medieval merchant guild office, warm dignified and inhabited, not a fantasy throne room or tavern. Grounded north-west European late-medieval inspired architecture, internally consistent stone and oak construction.
Scene: human-scale two-storey guildhall, approximately 18m wide, 26m deep, tall oak hammerbeam roof and lime plaster between believable stone piers; leaded arched glazed windows admitting soft neutral daylight, an open courtyard visible through a side arch. A central shared project table, individual writing alcoves to the left, a recessed council room with heavy timber door to the rear right, small archive gallery reached by a real stair and guarded by balustrade. Accessible unobstructed circulation. Two or three realistically proportioned adult coworkers in wool and linen quietly writing or consulting, no armor. Tables 0.75m high, sensible chairs with seat cushions and foot space. Stone threshold transitions into worn oak floor. Finely authored hand-hewn joinery, pegged beams, subtle surface variation at real-world scale, detailed carved but restrained door frames. Books, bound ledgers, wax seals, quills, ink and woven rugs placed with intent. Clear roof, floor and wall connections, grounded contact shadows, cool daylight and few warm shaded practical candles. No uniform orange filter.
Composition: one coherent wide cinematic interior at standing human eye-height, 28mm architectural lens, straight verticals, foreground joinery and desk corner, shared work centre middle distance, readable deep recesses. No UI overlay. Natural material colors: desaturated limestone, dark oak, flax textiles, sparse indigo and aged brass. Texture remains visible in shadows, no black crush. Dry stone, matte textile, varied wood roughness; realistic volumetric atmosphere extremely subtle.
Avoid: plastic shine, polished glossy floor, giant furniture, chunky low poly meshes, toy proportions, sci-fi screens, weapons, throne, videogame loot, excessive candles, enormous cathedral scale, magic glow, teal-orange grading, heavy fog, copied branded architecture, modern office equipment. Tiny understated bottom caption exactly "REALM / ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT". Render an exceptionally detailed wide landscape image.
prompts.characters:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: professional character art-direction sheet for Realm medieval coworking world, CONCEPT ONLY.
Primary request: photoreal AAA game character design, physically plausible 3D sculpt, subtle natural skin and garment details, neutral studio presentation with the material fidelity of an Unreal cinematic.
Composition: wide landscape production design board, warm gray uncluttered background, two thirds width a full-length lineup of four adult HUMAN medieval guild coworkers at shared physical ground scale, none cropped: female project steward with indigo wool gown under practical sleeveless surcoat and slim leather belt holding rolled plans; male craftsman with flax linen sleeves and weathered leather apron carrying a measuring tool; older female archivist with sage wool layers holding a leather-bound ledger; male treasurer with charcoal wool doublet and restrained brass clasp and a leather folio. Diverse believable facial features and natural skin tones, actual adult 7.5 to 8 head body proportions, ordinary builds from slim to stocky, natural hands, feet and posture. Ages 25 to 60. Late-medieval inspired tailoring with seams, lacing, garment weight, visible underlayers; sensible leather shoes, no armor or weapons, no crown.
Right third a clean 2x2 set of close views: one calm unretouched face with subtle pores, wool seam and flax weave, aged leather belt construction, hand resting naturally on ledger. Distinct panel dividers, no clutter. Full figures not overlapped by closeups. All share same visual world and believable low-sheen materials. Soft wide studio key, mild rim, neutral colors, fine hair strands gathered practically, diffuse skin with limited natural sheen. Subtle wear at hand contact and hems, clean cared-for clothing.
Avoid: chibi, cartoon, anime, exaggerated heroic musculature, sexualized costumes, oversized heads/hands, glossy waxy skin, allover scratches, modern fashion, exaggerated wizard robes, floating accessories, magic, game stat panels, tiny illegible labels. Small heading exactly "REALM / CHARACTER CONCEPT".
prompts.workstation:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: prop and material design board for a photoreal medieval 3D workplace called Realm, CONCEPT ONLY.
Primary request: highly authored AAA physically based 3D art direction at close viewing distance; one consistent practical writing workstation in a late-medieval merchant guildhall.
Composition: landscape board with 65 percent width a hero three-quarter eye-level close view of a solid oak writing desk with mortise-and-tenon frame, pegged joints, thin realistically beveled edges, real boards with end grain aligned correctly, modest linen-cushioned chair, kneehole space, leather-bound ledger opened to handwritten accounting, ceramic ink pot, quill, brass seal and folded flax cloth. Desk and chair sit firmly on matte irregular stone flags beside pale lime plaster and a leaded glazed window, shallow built-in oak book niche. Soft daylight across the desk. Warm practical light is very secondary. Human scale, attractive tidy working place, no generic overstuffed still life.
Right 35 percent: six material macro swatches in a neat two-column grid, photograph-like sample blocks: worn natural oak end grain and longitudinal grain; porous pale limestone with fine mortar; woven wool and flax; softly worn vegetable-tanned leather; black forged iron; tarnished brass. Show distinct material optical responses, restrained reflectivity only on metal. No spheres. Top-down macro lighting consistent, enough detail to see fibers and grain without oversharpening. Offwhite small gutters and understated typesetting.
Avoid: modern screens, chrome, varnished plastic, oversized furniture, giant wax puddles, skulls, weapons, generic glowing runes, embossed videogame UI, orange wash, saturated gold surfaces, excessive dirt. Small heading exactly "REALM / WORKSTATION & MATERIALS". No other text.
